meta.title: A home for cartoon art
meta.summary: A comic panel can make you laugh and carry history, too. At Ohio State, both sides of the page have a story.

Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum · Location & Hours

blocks.text: At Ohio State, the Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum gathers original art, published cartoons, comics, archives, and related materials. Its exhibitions bring that work into view beyond the reading room. I always like seeing an original drawing: the marks and corrections remind you that every familiar printed panel began with someone making choices by hand or through a deliberate process.

The museum also preserves cartoon art for researchers, teachers, and the public. I wouldn't rush through it as a nostalgia stop. Editorial cartoons, comic strips, and longer stories can reveal how people argued, played, and pictured their times. Galleries are open to the public, while special collections require a different kind of visit; check current exhibition details and reading-room guidance before you go.
